understanding.goal_understanding: The goal was to navigate through each level, modify the carried piece’s shape, color, and rotation as needed, and step onto every goal cell only when all three attributes matched its requirements. Completing all goals advances through the levels, and winning all levels completes the game.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Each move costs one stamina, and reaching zero stamina costs a life before resetting stamina. Walls block movement, so the blocked_directions state must be checked before every move and blocked directions must never be attempted. Shape modifiers cycle shapes 0–5, color modifiers cycle orange→blue→green→red→orange, and rotation modifiers turn the piece clockwise through 0°, 90°, 180°, and 270°. In this episode, the piece needed to reach the rotation changer at [19,30] to change from 270° to 0° before activating the goal at [34,10].
